Karbal Choon Qaidi Ban Ke Quran De Waris Jande Ne.
Sir Nangay Tak Ke Ayataan De Lashe Quran Sunande Ne.

1
Jis Bhain De Wal Kadi Takiya Nahi Ghazi Ne Nazraan Cha Ke.
Ghazi De Kolon Langdi Aye Ohh Zainab Rasiyaan Pa Ke.
Aynj Zaianb Nu Tarpande Ne Jiwein Ghazi Nu Dekhande Ne.
De Hukam Sajjad Aye Panchiyaan Nu Paigham Lay Jawan Mera.

2
Hasde Ne Mar Ke Aye Zalim Teri Rondi Aye Choti Zahra.
Lagda Aye Panchi Abid Aye Haye Najaf De Pasay Jande Ne.
Majboor Jadoon Aye Qaidi Haye Toor De Ne Safraan Te.
Pay Mitiyaan Naal Lokande Ne Sir Apne Baaj Rida De.

3
Aye Bhar Bhar Mitiyaan Sir Te Chadraan Di Tha Te Panday Ne.
IK Veer Da Saya Rab Ne Ik Bhain Di Chadar Paya.
 Zeeshan Si Chadar Zainab Di Abbas Da Si Ohh Saya.
Iss Kar Ke Ghazi Naal saye Chadar De V Uth Jande Ne.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/karbal-choon-qaidi-ban-ke-quran-de-waris-jande-ne-lyrics-in-punjabi-20-tajpoints-d3e18bd8d5a2861147ca.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for lyric, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = lyric.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert [len(b.splitlines()) for b in blocks] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
    assert [b.splitlines()[0].strip() for b in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified both editions contain a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and retained the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.

Updated the title and script metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag. I read “Zaianb” as زینب and “lokande” as لکاندے in the Shahmukhi text, keeping both Roman spellings as supplied.
